title: Original ATV artwork and local player lineup
summary: The garage picker uses the recovered QUADINFO multi_atv artwork, while local split-screen setup gains a colored, side-by-side Players lineup.
details: The lineup draws on recovered PAGE08 MultiATVRiderSelect evidence. The original reference is an approximate composite assembled from recovered assets, not a hardware capture.
PR #692 at 98b72f7 passed required CI and desktop/Android compilation. The exact artifact from CI run 43672863282 passed test_engine_split_seats.mjs in 25.1 seconds.
Inspected local two-player and three-player Players screenshots: the colored lineup shows selected ATV artwork and join slots. These first-iteration screenshots are not attached or published.

The phone-layout test timed out on an obsolete assertion expecting a single 3D preview on the Players page. The implementation owner is replacing that assertion with checks for all four player-card bounds and trimming transparent portrait padding; phone-layout retesting remains pending.
limitation: Original-game visual fidelity is not established by the approximate composite reference. Verification above applies to 98b72f7; the portrait-padding and phone-test follow-up changes still require verification. Browser checks ran on the host, not physical phones.
